duration_note: Circular central transit approximation, zero planet radius; disagreement is diagnostic, not an eccentric-orbit exclusion. BLS box duration is not full physical transit fit.
aperture_note: Potential eclipse depths assume target and neighbor have equal fractional aperture throughput; flux ratios use Tmag. Proper-motion corrected geometry is in Gaia sector table.
novelty: No exact target or TIC-cone-neighbor known signal matches; not a complete literature or alias certification.
